'''Leuese Mulan''' is a trading ship merchant from [[Tear]].

==Activities==
In {{ne|997}}, Leuese pulled up three [[heartstone]] bowls and a cup in his fishing nets. He didn't know what they were until [[Ailhuin Guenna]] told him. Because of the sale of the heartstone, he owns a trading ship. Despite the lucrative prospect of heartstone, Leuese can't remember where he found the bowls and cup.{{ref/book|3|48}}
